title: Cutting a clip on the timeline
note: To cut a timeline clip at the playhead, select that clip, then use Timeline > Current Clip > Cut Clip. The manual lists Shift+R as the default shortcut. The Razor Tool, selectable with X, is another way to cut a clip at a selected point; right-click > Cut Clip is also available.

title: Transform effect for zooms and movement
note: Kdenlive's Transform video effect adjusts size, position and rotation, and it supports keyframes. It includes X/Y/W/H/Size settings and on-monitor controls. To animate a zoom or movement, apply Transform to the relevant timeline clip, set values at different keyframe times, and preview the interpolation.

title: Position and Zoom effect and compatibility note
note: Position and Zoom adjusts the clip's size and position, with keyframe support and X/Y/W/H/Size parameters. The manual carries a warning about compositing artifacts reported for this effect in older releases; if problems appear, prefer the Transform effect instead. Do not assume this historical warning applies to every version.

title: Applying effects to clips and tracks
note: Open the Effects widget from View > Effects. Drag an effect onto a selected timeline clip to apply it there, or apply it to a Project Bin clip to affect that clip wherever used. Effects can also target tracks or the master output where supported. The order in the effect stack matters.

title: Keyframes, animation and easing
note: Kdenlive effects that support keyframes can interpolate parameter values between chosen times. Its effect controls offer interpolation types including linear, discrete, smooth and easing options; use smooth or eased transitions when you want movement to accelerate and settle rather than stop abruptly. Support depends on the specific effect.

title: Broken TV glitch using Nosync0r
note: The Nosync0r (Broken TV) effect simulates a horizontal-sync problem by shifting a frame and wrapping content at its bottom edge. The HSync parameter controls the offset and supports keyframes, making the effect useful for deliberately stylized analog-TV glitch motion. Preview the result with the source footage to keep the effect readable.

title: Timeline Selection, Razor and Spacer tools
note: The Kdenlive timeline includes Selection, Razor and Spacer tools. The manual lists S for Selection, X for Razor and M for Spacer. The Spacer Tool helps shift groups of later timeline clips together, which can help when inserting space or adjusting the edit's pacing.
